hooks.command: cmd=$(echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if echo $cmd | grep -qE 'rm -rf /|rm -rf \*'; then echo 'BLOCKED: rm -rf 금지. 특정 경로를 명시하세요.'; exit 2; fi; if echo $cmd | grep -qE '^sudo '; then echo 'BLOCKED: sudo 금지.'; exit 2; fi

file=$(echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if echo $file | grep -q '.py$' && [ -f "$file" ]; then result=$(ruff check "$file" 2>&1); if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "[RUFF] $file"; echo "$result" | head -20; fi; fi

file=$(echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if echo $file | grep -q '.py$' && [ -f "$file" ]; then result=$(mypy "$file" --no-error-summary 2>&1 | head -10); if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "[MYPY] $file"; echo "$result"; fi; fi
